title: LlamaIndex Parse Job
description: A parse job in LlamaParse representing the asynchronous processing of a document through AI-powered parsing with configurable tiers for different quality and speed trade-offs.

id.description: Unique identifier of the parse job.

status.description: Current processing status of the parse job.

tier.description: Parsing tier that determines quality and speed trade-off. Fast outputs spatial text only. Cost-effective is optimized for text-heavy documents. Agentic handles images and diagrams. Agentic-plus provides maximum fidelity for complex layouts.

version.description: API version used for parsing. Use 'latest' for most recent or a specific date string for production stability.

file_id.description: Identifier of the uploaded file being parsed.

source_url.description: URL of the document fetched for parsing, if provided instead of file_id.

num_pages.description: Total number of pages in the document.

target_pages.description: Page range to parse using 1-based indexing (e.g., '1-5', '3,7,10').

created_at.description: Timestamp when the parse job was created.

completed_at.description: Timestamp when the parse job completed.

ParseResult.description: The parsed output of a document containing extracted content in various formats.

text.description: Plain text representation of the parsed content.

markdown.description: Markdown-formatted representation of the parsed content.

json.description: Structured JSON representation of the parsed content.

ParsePage.description: Parsed content for a single page of a document.

text.description: Plain text content of the page.
